messages:
Ana C: Quick adoption pulse playbook draft — short checklist for 0-30d onboarding. Aim: reduce renewal risk by 20% via prefill/caching/batching + enablement sync. TL;DR below. :rocket:

Sam G: Nice. Can we add an 'at-risk' path for tenants with <10% daily DAU? Also need a kill-switch for large prefetch jobs.

Ana C: Yep. Added 'risk path' & throttle suggestion. Checklist:
- 1) Pre-fill top 5 intents with prefix cache (keep TTL 24h)
- 2) Warmup: gradual ramp to 50 reqs/min for first 24h (staggered)
- 3) Batching: max batch size 32 tokens / 4 requests (client-side cap)
- 4) Streaming fallback: use streaming for >500ms median lat to preserve UX
- 5) Telemetry hooks: churn signal + sample responses + eval regression alert

Jordan (SE): Warmup script suggestion for Dedicated/Private customers — run from a small control host to avoid noisy neighbour effects. Example (bash):
```
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
    -d '{"model":"xlarge-v1","input":"prefill: customer_top_utterances"}' &
  sleep 1
done
```
Notes: run with low concurrency, stagger across AZs, and add a per-tenant throttle flag.

Maria P: I'll turn this into a concise 1-pager + email template for CSM outreach. Also adding a handoff checklist to flag renewal risk at day 14 and day 28 (ops: set an alert if adoption score < 0.15).

Sam G: For renewal-risk tenants, recommend: daily QA sampling (5 responses/day) + automatic rollback triggers if eval quality drops >5% vs baseline. Add a temporary increased prefetch for short bursts to keep UX while we troubleshoot.

Ana C: Added QA sampling and in-app feedback flow. In-app short survey at day 7: 1) Is output meeting expectations? (yes/no), 2) Any latency issues? (yes/no), 3) Any integration blockers? (free text). Keep it sub-3 questions.

ops-bot: Template 'adoption-pulse-v1' created at /templates/adoption-pulse-v1 by Ana C

Ana C: Thanks all — please drop comments or quick reactions by EOD Wed. I'll consolidate and push to CS templates + share in #general.

Jordan (SE): +1 :thumbsup:
